servers.name: biomcp
servers.description: Biomedical evidence (read-only): ClinicalTrials.gov, ClinVar/ClinGen, gnomAD/GTEx/HPA, OncoKB/CIViC, cBioPortal study analytics, drugs, pathways. Requires biomcp-cli (uv tool install biomcp-cli); the wrapper puts ~/.local/bin on PATH.

servers.name: tooluniverse
servers.description: ToolUniverse gateway (2,700+ scientific tools; compact mode exposes only tool discovery/execution). Requires tooluniverse==1.5.7 (uv tool install); the wrapper puts ~/.local/bin on PATH.

servers.name: chatspatial
servers.description: Spatial transcriptomics analysis (Scanpy/Squidpy; Visium/Xenium/CosMx; spatial domains, deconvolution, cell communication). Conditional: heavy Python deps, and training-style methods can exceed the 60s MCP tool timeout.

servers.name: seqera
servers.description: Seqera Platform hosted MCP: workflow launch/monitoring, Wave containers, nf-core module discovery, SRA/ENA/GEO samplesheets. Conditional: requires a Seqera account and a Personal Access Token.

servers.name: biocontext
servers.description: Biomedical knowledge bases (read-only, hosted): OLS ontologies, Human Protein Atlas, PRIDE proteomics, PanglaoDB markers, ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA drugs, grants.gov, bioRxiv/medRxiv, Europe PMC, STRING, Reactome, InterPro, UniProt. No API key required.
